name: Tajikistan
famous_for: The Pamir Highway ('Roof of the World' road trip), crystal turquoise lakes of the Fann Mountains, and Silk Road citadels.
tourists: Over 1.0M adventure travelers; famous for Pamir Highway (M41), Iskanderkul alpine lake, and Wakhan Corridor petroglyphs.
must_know: Over 93% of Tajikistan's total territory is mountainous, with more than half the country sitting above 3,000 meters altitude.
fun_fact: The Pamir Highway is the second-highest international highway in the world, cresting the Ak-Baital Pass at 4,655 meters altitude.
